remarks: Enjoy the perfect balance of suburban tranquility and ultimate convenience! 56 Linden Street is ideally situated for easy living and seamless commuting. Located just minutes from I-95, the Merritt Parkway, and local train stations, this spacious home makes navigating Fairfield County a breeze.  Inside, you'll find a bright and open floor plan featuring three generously sized bedrooms and two full baths. The standout feature is the massive family room, which overlooks a private, fenced-in backyard-ideal for unwinding after a long day or hosting friends. The bright, airy layout provides fantastic spaces for both relaxation and entertaining. The spacious family room features vaulted ceilings and abundant sunshine from overhead skylights. Outside, a sprawling, fully fenced yard offers a private retreat perfect for gardening, playing, or weekend gatherings. With modern updates already in place, this home is a rare rental find. Beyond the property lines, you are within walking distance of local schools, parks, and fantastic shopping options.
